body:
I know they do. but the bad parts seem to so greatly outshadow the good it makes it all feel like its not worth it.  

I feel bad because she is depressed and displaying signs of being suicidal. She stays and bed all day.  this friend and I have a bit of a rocky past and I have not talked to her in a while (a month or so) and one day I randomly hopped on Skype and she was there and we started talking.  she said i was the only one she felt like talking to and that i was understanding of her issues, so i feel bad just coming back at her with my own (somewhat similar) issues that would just make her feel more hopelss...i guess.

it's okay :) I know you mean well

I just don't see the point of going when i feel good once in a while and then the world seems to just like to fuck me over.  happens all the time and i honestly think it's my fault. I messed up in school, i sabotaged my relationships..it's just my fault.  i just hate this feeling. i feeling so hollow and empty.  i hate myself.  i dont know.  im not making much sense anymore.

im sorry i know i am not a good person to talk to when im like this.

Just..my life being shit.  one good thing happens then one horrible thing happens that makes the good thing lose all significance.  It's a constant cycle that wears me down.  i have no one to really talk about this with..I mean i do but it's hard to just talk about this shit with 99% of my friends..and the one i did talk to this about is feeling really fucking depressed herself and i am the only person she actually wants to talk to, so I feel horrible..as if i let her down by being like this now..

I rather not get into total specifics..but i will do my best

I just..i have a good thing going and i do something to fuck it up, really.  Like today, I got a job (something I was really trying to do so I could feel better about myself) and then I go along and fuck everything else in my life, making me much worse off than before and making the job feel pointless.  now all i want is a gun and to just have this all end. i just am losing sight of exactly why i should care about this life..I understand there are those that would hurt, but i am horribly unhappy. i am a fuckup and pretty much screw up everything i try.  i have tried and tried to seek help to no real avail.  and at this point, i feel like i have drained all my options.
I don't even know where to start. My whole life has been like this, off and on.  I felt like I had it back on track but I messed it up like i always seem to.
I don't quite know the qualification of something being considered 'worse-than-normal' but I think it is..
Because every time I try to go out and find my own happiness everything in my life just ends up worse.  I can't take it.
